question: Which bank has officially partnered with Sunrisers Hyderabad (SRH) as its exclusive banking partner in March 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**City Union Bank**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **City Union Bank** officially partnered with Sunrisers Hyderabad (SRH) as its exclusive banking partner in March 2025.
 
• The partnership marks a strategic collaboration for enhancing City Union Bank's visibility through the Indian Premier League (IPL).
 
• SRH, a prominent IPL team, has been sponsored by various renowned brands, and this collaboration adds to its credibility.
 
• City Union Bank aims to leverage the IPL's massive viewership to promote its banking services and expand its customer base.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **City Union Bank:**

 
 
• Established in 1904, City Union Bank is one of the oldest private sector banks in India.
 
• Headquartered in Kumbakonam, Tamil Nadu, the bank has a strong focus on small and medium enterprises (SMEs) and retail banking.
 
 
 
• **Sunrisers Hyderabad (SRH):**
 
 
• Sunrisers Hyderabad is a franchise cricket team that plays in the Indian Premier League (IPL).
 
• The team was founded in 2012 and has won the IPL title once, in 2016.
 
 
 
• **Indian Premier League (IPL):**
 
 
• The IPL is one of the most popular T20 cricket leagues globally, organized by the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI).
 
• It serves as a platform for brands to gain immense visibility due to its large fan base and extensive media coverage.
 
 
 
• **Brand Partnerships in IPL:**
 
 
• Partnerships with IPL teams allow brands to engage with diverse audiences and enhance their market presence.
 
• Sponsorships often include jersey branding, advertising, and co-marketing initiatives.
